title: Chapter 763 Another Holy Lord; Hatred From Mythological Characters!
content:
Chapter 763 Another Holy Lord; Hatred From Mythological Characters!

Chapter 763 Another Holy Lord; Hatred From Mythological Characters!

Following that, Lin Fan communicated with Li Ke's soul and raised his cultivation state to Universe Level 5. He also imparted the Fire Attribute cultivation technique of the Holy Lord level to him.

The rapid growth of his cultivation, coupled with his superb talent, made Li Ke's position in the Fire God Palace even more stable.

Lin Fan had only casually done these things. He didn't take them to heart at all.

He continued his leisurely life.

....

Lin Fan was relaxed, but some people were like stray dogs, extremely pitiful.

In the distant starry sky, the Bodhi Fruit had paid a huge price to travel through space several thousand times in a row to arrive at the unknown territory.

He took a few deep breaths before recovering some strength.

"I finally got rid of him."

"But, what exactly is going on?"

"Tai Ba and Bo Han were both cursed to death! Cursing them involved huge karma. Was he not afraid of karma backlash?"

The Bodhi Fruit was the karma dao.

Just as everyone had expected, he indeed possessed extremely powerful curses.

However, it could only slightly affect a Holy Lord.

In fact, the Bodhi Fruit did not dare to curse casually.

This was because the world was fair.

Once he cursed someone, heaven and earth would double the backlash.

To be able to curse and kill two Holy Lords, and at the same time, be able to withstand the backlash of heaven and earth…

Who was the other party?

Just how strong was he?

Why did he put the blame on her?

Bodhi Guo's expression changed. Then, as if he had thought of something, his pupils constricted slightly.

He suddenly raised his head and looked into the endless sky.

After hesitating for a moment, he gritted his teeth and soared into the sky.

Above the 49th Heaven.

In a snow-white space.

A huge golden Buddha statue that was comparable to heaven and earth stood in the air.

Bodhi Guo knelt down and said respectfully,"Greetings, Sacred Ancestor Bodhi.""

"Buzz!"

The huge golden Buddha statue slowly opened its eyes, shooting out endless dazzling golden light.

The originally white space seemed to be dyed with a layer of gold under the golden light.

"What is it?" The golden Buddha statue gently opened its mouth and let out a deafening sound.

Bodhi Guo said in panic,"Divine Ancestor, the Buddha Realm…" It's gone."

"Boom!"

A terrifying pressure of heaven and earth suddenly descended, directly crushing the Bodhi Fruit onto the ground and spitting out a large mouthful of golden blood.

Just his aura alone was enough to injure a Holy Lord expert until he spat out blood. How powerful!

"Bodhi Fruit, back then, you swore that you would spread the Buddha Realm throughout the myriad worlds. That was why I allowed you to become the Lord of the Buddha Realm and allowed you to reach the realm of the Holy Master. Hmm?" The giant golden Buddha said sternly.

An even more terrifying aura whizzed down.

"Puff!"

The Bodhi Fruit spat out another mouthful of golden blood.

"Holy Ancestor, please calm down. Holy Ancestor, please calm down…" he said in fear.

"I was framed…"

"Originally, I managed the Buddha World very well. This is the power of virtue over the years…"

As soon as he finished speaking, a thick golden dragon of virtue soared into the sky, its voice shaking the nine heavens.

When the giant golden Buddha saw this, its aura eased slightly.

Thus, Bodhi Guo seized the opportunity to speak." The Lord of the Monster Race, Tai Ba, and the Lord of the Ocean, Bo Han, were cursed to death one after another. Then, everyone said that it was my doing. Especially Bo Han. Before he was cursed to death, he even launched a self-destruction attack on my Buddha Realm. At the same time, he cursed me at the cost of his life."

"I'm already cursed."

"I suspect that there might be a Saint King behind this. The other party wants to completely destroy our Buddha Realm!"

Upon hearing this, the giant golden Buddha slowly raised its mountain-like fingers and quickly pinched them.

After a while, he put down his finger.

He was actually unable to calculate the culprit of the lower realm.

It must be understood that Subhuti was also a Karmic Dao user.

His divination skills were definitely top-notch among the Saint Kings.

In the end, even he could not figure out the culprit.

This could explain many problems.

Subhuti began to analyze the situation in his heart. Who could possibly have done such a thing?

A few names appeared in his mind.

He was furious.

As far as Subhuti was concerned, this was a provocation, a declaration of war!

Unforgivable!

A moment later, Subhuti finally spoke."

"Take this treasure and you won't be afraid of any Holy Master. After that, you will descend to the lower realm with Pu Xin and rebuild the Buddha Realm!"

As soon as he finished speaking, he casually waved his hand, and a golden pearl appeared in front of the Bodhi Fruit.

The Bodhi Fruit sensed the tyrannical power contained within the golden pearl and said excitedly,"Thank you, Divine Ancestor!"

Then, a short and thin middle-aged man appeared beside him.

His body was suffused with holy light.

This was the Pu Xin that Subhuti had spoken of.

Another Sacred Lord!

"Go!" Subhuti said.

"Yes, Divine Ancestor!" Pu Guo and Pu Xin said in unison.

....

Thus, the Bodhi Fruit that had disappeared for a long time reappeared in the 33rd Layer of Heaven.

As soon as he appeared, he immediately attracted the attention of many Holy Lords.

Presently, all the Saint Sovereigns had already regarded Pu Guo as someone they must kill.

Since he had to kill them, he had to kill them as soon as possible.

Otherwise, it would be too late for regrets!

In the past, Bodhi Guo would always try to escape as soon as possible when he was surrounded.

Now, he was calmly waiting at his original spot.

"Boom!"

"Boom!"

The tyrannical attack landed on Bodhi Guo's body, but it did not cause any effect on him.

That was because a golden protective barrier had appeared on the surface of the Bodhi Fruit, blocking all attacks.

Seeing this, the corners of Pu Guo's mouth curled up slightly, revealing a smile.

Then, he put his palms together and said, Amitabha."

"Patrons, I have something to say!"

"卍!"

At the same time, Pu Xin who was beside him also opened her mouth and said,""卍!"

The two golden swastikas were like two suns as they crushed toward the two people at the front.

"What?" The Holy Masters were shocked.

"Another Holy Master!"

They still had a sliver of confidence in killing a Sacred Lord.

However, it was impossible to kill two Sacred Lords.

Moreover, the Bodhi Fruit had displayed an extremely powerful defensive equipment earlier…

Under such circumstances, wanting to surround and kill him was simply a fantasy.

Thus, a Sacred Master said," Daoist Bodhi Fruit, perhaps there's a misunderstanding."

Bodhi Guo responded with a smile.

The crisis was instantly resolved.

....

On the other hand.

Earth, Coiling Dragon Villa.

As usual, Lin Fan accompanied Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others to stroll in the garden after eating their fill. He was extremely relaxed and at ease.

A flock of birds flew over their heads, and everyone smiled when they saw it.

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan's mind.

[Ding! [Bodhi has generated hatred towards you. Current Hatred Points: 2 stars.]]

When Lin Fan heard this, his brows twitched.

Subhuti?

This was the first name that appeared in his mind.

However, it was a name that resounded in his ears like thunder.

This was because this name often appeared in myths and legends on Earth.

As for him…It actually existed?

Moreover, he even generated Hatred Points towards him?
